status: Partial synthetic wire fixtures; user approved whole OSC5522 service; NOT full acceptance suite/conformance proof; examples not executed.
policy_label_note: Consumer PNG preference/Tau artifact cap do not restrict terminal MIME offer/service. Existing cases are partial illustrative coverage; engineers own full writes/native-owner/mux/backpressure acceptance.

conventions.wire: JSON strings decode to exact ASCII bytes; no literal formatting spaces.
conventions.directions: Application is the TUI; terminal may include multiplexer routing.
conventions.local: Non-wire event; never write to terminal.
conventions.tokens: Predictable fixture values only; never use them in production.
conventions.expected: Semantic assertions/proposed consumer results, not observed executions.
conventions.hex: Lowercase hex of decoded bytes. PNG bytes are opaque, not image-decoder validated.

cases.name: lifecycle_pause_resume_cleanup
premises: Initially supported mutable mode, enabled and owned by application.

cases.name: optional_no_token_offer
premises: Standard permission policy denies this read; absence of token alone does not mandate EPERM.

cases.name: read_error_EPERM
premises: Permission denied.

cases.name: read_error_EBUSY
premises: Temporary contention.

cases.name: read_error_ENOSYS
premises: Primary selection unavailable on this system.

cases.name: multiple_mimes_unavailable_ignored
premises: User/system grants read; PNG and plaintext available; application/x-unavailable absent. Order illustrated, not mandated.

cases.name: independently_padded_read_chunks
premises: Permission granted. Do NOT concatenate padded base64 strings before decoding.

cases.name: 4096_byte_boundary
premises: Permission granted.

cases.name: transport_fragmented_OSC_and_ST
premises: Permission granted; transport fragments are not clipboard DATA chunks.
Initial isolated ESC is followed by introducer byte before approved25ms deadline; lossless split guarantee applies after introducer recognition, not indefinitely delayed ESC.

cases.name: stale_id_during_current_read
premises: old-01 belongs to an expired earlier read; never reinterpret id-bearing packets as an unsolicited offer.

cases.name: grant_wrong_location
premises: Token was issued for primary.
Standard permission policy denies unauthenticated reads.
Request targets default clipboard, not primary.

cases.name: grant_without_name
premises: Token was issued for primary.
Standard permission policy denies unauthenticated reads.
pw without name has no password authority.

cases.name: grant_replayed
premises: Token was issued for primary.
Standard permission policy denies unauthenticated reads.
Token was already used by a completed earlier read.

cases.name: grant_expired
premises: Token was issued for primary.
Standard permission policy denies unauthenticated reads.
Terminal short timeout has elapsed; exact timeout is not specified.

cases.name: busy_new_gesture_rejected_before_paste_event
premises: Do not call the rejected GUI action an accepted paste event; accepted events require an offer.

cases.name: wrong_pane_grant_denied
premises: Token belongs to pane/attachment A; request comes from pane/attachment B; deny-by-default.

cases.name: unused_grant_replaced
premises: No read active; second accepted user gesture replaces unused grant.
